cohort: 265 pregnant women with prosthetic heart valves
finding: The study found a higher incidence of thrombus formation in women with mechanical heart valves compared to bioprosthetic valves, while women with bioprosthetic valves had a significantly higher rate of normal pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with bioprosthetic valves had a higher rate of normal pregnancy outcomes compared to those with mechanical valves (91.57% vs. 61.54%, p<0.05).
